signedOut.title: Create your account and publish
signedOut.body: You need an account to fill in your listing. It takes less than two minutes, and you land back on this same page to finish it.

plans.title: Want to see the plans first?
plans.body: Check what each plan includes and what it costs. You can come back to this page whenever you want.

meta.title: Publish your food and drink venue
meta.description: List your restaurant, bar, grill or food truck on Hospeda and reach the travellers looking for somewhere to eat in the Litoral region.

hero.title: List your venue and let people find it
hero.body: Start here with the basics: your venue's name, what kind it is and which destination it's in. Photos, menu and opening hours come later, from your dashboard.

step1.title: Fill in the basics
step1.desc: Name, venue type and destination. That's all we need to create your listing right away.

step2.title: Complete your listing
step2.desc: Add photos, menu, opening hours and contact details from the dashboard, at your own pace.

step3.title: You go live
step3.desc: Your venue shows up in the gastronomy catalogue and diners in the area find you.

item1.title: Seen by people already here
item1.desc: Thousands of travellers look for somewhere to eat in Concepción del Uruguay and the Litoral region every month.

item2.title: The listing is yours
item2.desc: Change the menu, the photos and the opening hours whenever you want, without asking anyone.

item3.title: No fee per enquiry
item3.desc: You pay your plan and that's it. No booking or enquiry adds a separate charge.

meta.title: Publish your experience
meta.description: List your tour, outing or workshop on Hospeda and reach the travellers already looking for things to do in the Litoral region.

hero.title: List your experience and fill it up
hero.body: Start here with the basics: what you offer, what kind it is and which destination you set off from. Photos, meeting point and schedules come later, from your dashboard.

step1.title: Tell us what you offer
step1.desc: Name, experience type and destination. That's all we need to create your listing right away.

step2.title: Complete your listing
step2.desc: Add photos, meeting point, duration and schedules from the dashboard, at your own pace.

step3.title: You go live
step3.desc: Your experience shows up in the catalogue and travellers already in the area find you.

item1.title: Seen by people who already travelled
item1.desc: Whoever books a place to stay in the Litoral region then looks for things to do, and that's where you show up.

item2.title: The listing is yours
item2.desc: Change photos, schedules and prices whenever you want, without asking anyone.

item3.title: No fee per booking
item3.desc: You pay your plan and that's it. No booking or enquiry adds a separate charge.
